definitions.explanation: A lotion, spray, or cream applied to the skin to protect it from the sun's ultraviolet rays and prevent sunburn.

examples.japanese: {日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}めを{塗|ぬ}る。
{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}めを{忘|わす}れた。
{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}めを{塗|ぬ}ってから{外|そと}に{出|で}る。
examples.english: I apply sunscreen before going outside.

examples.japanese: {汗|あせ}をかいたので{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}めを{塗|ぬ}り{直|なお}した。
examples.english: I reapplied sunscreen because I was sweating.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}は{毎朝|まいあさ}{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}めを{塗|ぬ}らないと、すぐに{肌|はだ}が{赤|あか}くなってしまう。
examples.english: In summer, if I don't apply sunscreen every morning, my skin gets red right away.

notes:
Composed of {日焼|ひや}け (sunburn) + {止|ど}め (stopper/prevention). Refers to any product that protects skin from UV rays — cream, lotion, or spray.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}めを{塗|ぬ}る: to apply sunscreen
- {日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}めを{塗|ぬ}り{直|なお}す: to reapply sunscreen
- {日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}めクリーム: sunscreen cream
- {日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}めスプレー: sunscreen spray

USAGE:
Very common in daily conversation, especially during summer. Products are rated by SPF ({紫外線|しがいせん}{防御|ぼうぎょ}{指数|しすう}) and PA (protection grade).

RELATED:
- {日焼|ひや}け: sunburn, suntan
- {紫外線|しがいせん}: ultraviolet rays
- {日傘|ひがさ}: parasol, sun umbrella
